name: Messenger to Westfall
summary: Magistrate Solomon sends a plea from Lakeshire to Westfall for help against the Blackrock orcs and gnolls. With Stormwind's forces absent, he hopes Gryan Stoutmantle's People's Militia can lend aid.

sections.title: A Desperate Appeal
sections.body: Blackrock orcs and gnolls besiege Lakeshire, and the Stormwind Army has not arrived in force. Magistrate Solomon knows the town guards and irregulars cannot hold the Redridge Mountains alone. With no royal reserves in sight, he writes a formal plea for help. Word has reached him of a citizen defense group forming west of Elwynn Forest, so he sends his appeal there.

sections.title: Reaching Across Borders
sections.body: Gryan Stoutmantle is a veteran commander rallying volunteer fighters under the People's Militia banner. Solomon sends his dispatch across the kingdom, hoping Westfall's volunteers can reinforce Lakeshire's borders until the Crown's armies mobilize. But Westfall is fighting its own desperate struggle against the Defias Brotherhood.

faq.q: Why is Magistrate Solomon asking Westfall for help?
faq.answer: Stormwind has not sent the reinforcements Lakeshire needs against the orcs and gnolls. Solomon has heard that an armed citizen force is gathering in Westfall, and hopes Gryan Stoutmantle can spare troops for Redridge.

Gryan Stoutmantle is a veteran soldier at Sentinel Hill in Westfall. With Crown authority and protection absent, he formed and leads the People's Militia to defend local farmsteads from brigands and the Defias Brotherhood.

faq.q: Where does this courier journey lead?
faq.answer: You carry the message from Lakeshire's town hall west across Redridge and Elwynn Forest to Sentinel Hill in central Westfall.

faq.q: Why hasn't the Stormwind Army relieved Lakeshire?
faq.answer: Magistrate Solomon says something is amiss with the army, since promised troops have not arrived. The king is absent and Highlord Bolvar Fordragon rules as regent, while outlying territories are left to fend for themselves without the expected reserves.

faq.q: Can Westfall actually spare any troops for Redridge?
faq.answer: No. When you reach Sentinel Hill, Westfall is barely holding together against the Defias Brotherhood. The People's Militia has no troops to spare and struggles to protect its own borders.

faq.q: What comes after delivering the letter?
faq.answer: Gryan Stoutmantle receives the message and drafts a reply explaining Westfall's dire situation. He sends you back to Magistrate Solomon with his response.

angles.text: This dispatch shows how little central defense remains in the Kingdom of Stormwind, leaving border towns to seek mutual aid on their own.
As a human, you share the hardships of settlers in Redridge and Westfall, who rely on volunteers and mercenaries while the capital sits idle.
